title: basic measuring set
text: basic measuring set. These are your basic measuring spoons... what you see in the ad is exactly what I received. They are lightweight and stood up to washing in the dishwasher. They are about 5" in length... fix in a drawer... I keep them looped together for ease in finding the one I want, but you could separate them. I always update my reviews if any issues arise, but I don't expect any in this case...
